title: QuantOS Terminal BFF API component schemas

DecimalValue.description: 十进制定点字符串（proto DecimalValue.value；禁 IEEE-754 交易计算）

RuntimeMode.description: assisted_live 仅 M5+ 且服务端 flag/capability 放行才可见；客户端不得硬编码可用性

DataQuality.description: 未知值客户端显示"未知/需升级"并阻断高风险动作

message.description: 安全可展示文案（i18n key 由客户端映射）

uri.description: One-time otpauth enrollment URI for the authenticated user only; never persist, log, cache or send to analytics. Idempotent job replay omits this material.

payloadVersion.description: Canonical v1; legacy 1 remains supported during the 1.4.0 migration window. Other versions fail closed.

payload.description: 领域事件载荷；payload.type=permission_revoked 为终态语义

capabilities.description: capability key 全集（权限裁剪唯一来源）

criticalBypass.description: Critical 可绕过静默但仍受服务端授权策略约束

availableMfaMethods.description: Server-enabled enrollment methods. WebAuthn requires a separately enabled provider capability; unavailable methods fail closed.

firstFactorSetupRef.description: Fresh IdP-authentication grant scoped only to enrollment of the first factor and cancellation of an unverified enrollment; never authorizes other security mutations.

lastVerifiedAt.description: Latest trusted primary sign-in or successful MFA verification timestamp; never derived from session expiry.

ipMasked.description: 仅脱敏 IP，禁止返回完整地址

downloadUrl.description: BFF 短时签名 URL；不得写入日志或持久化

actor.description: 已脱敏的 actor 显示名或服务主体

redactedPayload.description: 只允许服务端脱敏后输出；密钥、token、完整账户标识禁止出现

route.description: 只含资源引用，不含 token

complete.description: true 仅表示当前授权范围内证据链完整

downloadUrl.description: 一次性不透明签名 URL，最长 5 分钟

qualityBlocked.description: 质量受限阻断标识（服务端权威，前端不可覆盖）

leakViolations.description: 泄漏检查失败规则码（非空阻断 Release）

allowedTargets.description: 服务端权威；M3/M4 仅 paper/shadow；assisted_live 出现需 flag 放行

stale.description: true 时命令类操作由服务端拒绝

correlationId.description: Trace reference for control actions; also supplied in response headers.

counterViews.description: 反方观点（R04 强制；proto trading.v1.TradeProposal.counter_views）

originator.description: 发起人 actorId（禁自批判定）

commandRef.description: 批准后签发的短时 TradeCommand 引用

cancelCommandRef.description: Server-owned order control reference for authenticated requester cancellation; does not renew the original submit TTL or grant submit authority.

ArtifactAttachment.description: 授权后返回已校验hash的JSON内容；不返回内部存储路径或可转发的Storage凭据。
